glycan_model: Representative N-glycan, simplified 12-sugar linear model at each N-glycosylation site
area_difference_convention: dSASA = SASA_unglycosylated - SASA_with_glycans; positive = glycan occludes
sasa_algorithm: Probe-based SASA (NACCESS/FreeSASA-consistent), probe radius 1.4 A, 24 probes/sphere
note: Matched-conditions computation. The paper's ~1,299 A^2 is for their mature construct with a conformational-diversity N-glycan ensemble; our value uses a simplified single-conformation glycan model and is NOT directly comparable.
